data.body: RP-01 clarification D1 approved with caveat. Decision: use one operation-wide Pydantic request_limit shared by tool turns and output-validation retries, sized as the existing base request allowance plus the configured bounded output-retry allowance. Intentional delta: once that combined allowance is consumed, the run raises UsageLimitExceeded; unlike the current manual prompted path, no output attempt receives a reset full Agent budget. Maintainer caveat, recorded verbatim: “let's explicitly document our plan to raise the limit if this becomes an issue.” Operational plan: retain request/tool consumption in sanitized diagnostics and run telemetry. If focused regressions or production evidence show legitimate structured-output recovery being starved by the shared ceiling, create a normal plan-reviewed follow-up to raise the derived request allowance while preserving one-operation shared-counter semantics; do not restore per-attempt resets or add a second retry engine. Recovery note and report were updated. Next unresolved decision: retry-message wire shape and the existing 2,000-character faulty-output bound.
